facts.fact: The Government Information Service says the National Productivity and Competitiveness Council's AI StartUps programme gave five winning teams Rs 100,000 each as seed funding with incubation support, from 157 registrations and 19 pitching teams.

MUS.note: The programme gives incubation support but names no hub, incubator or park.
